facts.fact: C-Saude says the Ministry of Health's Health Information Department is designing the SIS-RME electronic medical record, with 15 embedded C-Saude specialists under an MoU.
C-Saude says it supported the ministry's nationwide Health Information Systems Strategy, which guides digital investments including the SIS-RME.
C-Saude, PEPFAR's local implementing institution, provides the embedded specialists building the SIS-RME.

MOZ.note: Interoperability and a patient identifier are planned for SIS-RME; no exchange in service or piloted.
Nothing stated on the national HMIS.
The system is built by embedded partner specialists; ministry staff are only being mentored.
